Brahma, the louts born, modest and celibate consoled Indra, the king of god with these words-"O god of gods! Don't be anxious in the matter as Arjuna will at last enjoy the fruit of victory.

sa: दीक्षादमपरः शान्तः स्वाध्यायपरमः शुचिः। उपवासविशुद्धात्मा सततं सत्त्वमास्थितः॥
en: Observing strict regulations and selfrestraint, of great and pure soul, always making Vedic recitations, and of heart purified by facts, he treated all creatures with goodness.

sa: शरीराणि विमोक्ष्यामस्तपसोग्रेण सत्तम। आश्रमाणां विशेषं त्वमथाचक्ष्व पितामह॥
en: O best of men, we shall, therefore, reduce our bodies with the austerest of penances! Tell me, O grand-father, what mode of life I should follow.

sa: जम्बूद्वीपेन सदृशः क्रौञ्चद्वीपो नराधिप। अधरेण महामेरोर्दण्डेन मृदितस्त्वया॥
en: You had also, O king, governed with might, that other region called Kraunchadvipa situated on the west of the great Meru and equal to Jambudvipa itself!

sa: क्रव्यादैः कृष्यमाणानामपरेषां महात्मनाम्। शातकौम्भ्यः सजश्चित्रा विप्रकीर्णाः समन्ततः॥
en: The beautiful golden garlands on the necks of other illustrious heroes, as the latter and being dragged by carnivorous creatures, are scattered about on all sides.

sa: सर्वोपायैर्निहन्तव्यः पापो निकृतिजीवनः॥ धनमित्येव पापानां सर्वेषामिह निश्चयः।
en: Such a sinful wight living by deceit should be killed by all means. Such sinful creatures do not see anything in this world superior to wealth.

sa: युधिष्ठिरोऽपि संक्रुद्धो माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। गार्धपत्रै:शितैर्बाणैर्निन्युर्वै यमसादनम्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira also, worked up with anger and the two sons of Madri, began to kill those elephant-warriors with arrows having wings like those of vultures.

sa: राजानो हतशिष्टास्त्वां राजन्नभित आसते। धर्माननुयुयुक्षन्तस्तेभ्यः प्रब्रूहि भारत॥
en: The unslain residue of the kings are sitting around you, desirous of hearing your discourses on morality and duty. Do you speak to them, O Bharata.

sa: गोमायवश्चानुकूला बलगृध्राश्च सर्वशः। अर्हयेयुर्यदा सेनां तदा सिद्धिरनुत्तमा।।७।
en: The jackals, ravens and vultures become auspicious to them. When these show such regard to the army, great success is sure to be achieved by it.

sa: प्रकीर्णकेशां सुश्रोणी दुर्योधनशुभाङ्कगाम्। रुक्मवेदीनिभां पश्य कृष्ण लक्ष्मणमातरम्॥
en: Behold, O Krishna, the mother of Lakshmana, that lady having large hips, with her hairs disheveled, that dear wife of Duryodhana, resembling a golden sacrificial altar.

sa: धर्मव्युच्छित्तिमिच्छन्तो येऽधर्मस्य प्रवर्तकाः। हन्तव्यास्ते दुरात्मानो देवैर्दैत्या इवोल्बणाः॥
en: Those wicked persons who desire to root out virtue and encourage sinfulness deserve io be killed even as the furious Daityas were killed by the gods.

sa: श्वेतपर्वतरूपेभ्यो गृहेभ्यस्तास्त्वपाक्रमन्। गुहाभ्य इव शैलानां पृषत्यो हतयूथपाः॥
en: Indeed, they came out of their houses looking like white mountains, like a herd of deer from their mountain caves after the fall of their leader.

sa: अमार्गेणैवमारभ्य घोरामापदमागतः। तां चापदं घोरतरां प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: It is described by the wise as a terrible calamily when one through fear, cannot achieve a great feat after having tried to do the same.

sa: रथैर्वरेघून्मथितैः सुकल्पैः सयोधशस्त्रैश्च वरायुधैर्ध्वजैः। निकृत्तचक्राक्षयुगत्रिवेणुभिः॥ हतानुकर्विनिषङ्गबन्धनैः। प्रभग्निनीडैर्मणिहेमभूषितै स्तृता मही द्यौरिव शारदैर्घनैः॥ । पेतुश्च खङ्गा
en: Well equipt cars were crushed by their arrows along with the warriors, weapons and standards. Their wheels, joints, axles, yokes, Trivenus, Upaskaras, Amikarsanas, the seats of the drivers and the fixtures of quivers were all broken into pieces. Covered with all these the Earth looked like the sky covered with autumnal clouds.

sa: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गा विप्रविद्धैर्नियन्तृभिः। हयाः परिपतन्ति स्म शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Horses, with limbs covered with blood on account of wounds inflicted by horsemen themselves struck with arrows, dropped down on all sides in hundreds and thousands.

sa: गुरोरप्यवलिप्तस्य कार्याकार्यमजानतः। उत्पथं प्रतिपन्नस्य दण्डो भवति शासनम्॥
en: The very preceptor, if he is haughty, ignorant of what should be done and what should not, and an impious person, should be restrained by Punishment.

sa: टिट्टिभं तमुपेक्षेत वाशमानमिवातुरम्। लोकविद्वेषमापन्नो निष्फलं प्रतिपद्यते॥ इति संश्लाघते नित्यं तेन पापेन कर्मणा। इदमुक्तो मया कश्चित् सम्मतो जनसंसदि॥
en: An intelligent man should pay no attention to an utterer of abusive words who resembles, after all, only a Tittibha uttering dissonant notes. One, who is possessed by hate is said to live in vain. A fool is often heard to say,-I addressed such words to such a respectable man amid such an assembly of men!-and to cven boast of that wicked act.

sa: धर्ममेकेऽभिपद्यन्ते कल्याणाभिजना नराः। परत्र सुखमिच्छन्तो निर्विद्येयुश्च लौकिकात्॥
en: Some righteous and highly-born persons devote themselves to the acquisitions of virtue. These every king of worldly happiness from securing the same in the other world.

sa: श्यामानां वरवर्णानां गौरीणामेकवाससाम्। दुर्योधनवरस्त्रीणां पश्य वृन्दानि केशव॥
en: Hearing each other's unmeaning lamentations those ladies, on account of the loud cries of woe coming from every side, are unable to understand each other's meaning.

sa: तान्युदीर्णानि नारीणां तदा वृन्दान्यनेकशः। शोकार्तान्यद्रवन् राजन् किशोरीणामिवाङ्गने॥
en: Those bevies of fair damsels, O king, came out filled with sorrow, and ran here and here like a herd of fillies on a circus yard.

sa: सिंहनादांस्ततश्चकुः श्वेडाश्च भरतर्षभ। त्वरिता क्षत्रिया राजञ्जग्मुद्वैपायनं ह्रदम्॥
en: The warriors sent forth leonine roars, O foremost of Bharata's race and cried loudly. All the Kshatriyas, O king, went quickly towards that lake called Dvaipayana.

sa: निष्ठुरं वैरपुरुषं वृद्धानां शासनातिगम्। कथमात्मकृतं दोषं मय्याधातुमिहेच्छसि॥
en: Highly ruthless, he was the embodiment of hostilities, and disobedient to the commands of the old. Why do you then attribute your own faults to me?

sa: हैरण्यान् योजनोत्सेधानायतान् दशयोजनम्। अतिरिक्तान् द्विजातिभ्यो व्यभजस्त्वितरे जनाः॥
en: Those fishes were each ten Yojanas in length and one in breadth. The residue after gratifying the Brahmanas, were divided amongst themselves by the other classes.

sa: तां वज्रमणिरत्नौघकल्मषां वज्रगौरवाम्॥ समुद्यम्य महाबाहुः शल्यमभ्यपतद् रणे।
en: Taking up that mace which was set with diamonds and other gems, eight-sided and celebrated as Indra's thunder-the mightyarmed son of Pandu now ruslied against Shalya.

sa: बाणभूतामपश्याम पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते। दुर्योधनेन प्रकृतां क्षिप्रहस्तेन धन्विना॥
en: The Earth then, O king, was as if converted into one sheet of arrows by your son Duryodhana, that bowman endued with great lightness of hand.

sa: तवापराधदस्माभिर्धातरस्ते निपातिताः। निहता ज्ञातयश्चापि दिष्टं मन्ये दुरत्ययम्॥
en: For your folly your brothers, mighty carwarriors all, and your kinsmen, have been killed by us! I think all this is the work of irresistible Destiny!

sa: एवं लोकानुरोधेन शास्त्रमेतन्महर्षिभिः। संक्षिप्तमायुर्विज्ञाय मानां ह्रासमेव च॥
en: Considering the period of human existence and the general decrease (of every thing), great Rishis did thus, for the well-being of the world, abridge that science.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा द्रौणिरास्थाय तां वेदी दीप्तपावकाम्। संत्यज्यात्मानमारुद्य कृष्णवर्त्मन्युपाविशात्॥
en: Having said so, Drona's son, ascending that sacrificial altar on which a fire was burning, offered himself up as the victim and entered that burning fire.

sa: पाण्डवापि महाराज लब्धलक्ष्याः प्रहारिणः। अपश्यमानाः समरे दुर्योधनमवस्थितम्॥
en: The Pandavas of pure aim and expert in fighting, O monarch, not seeing in battle Duryodhana who was then concealed, were taking rest in their camp.

sa: मुनिरुवाच महर्षिभगवांस्तेन पूर्वमासीद् विमानितः। बालिशां बुद्धिमास्थाय मन्दभाग्यतयाऽऽत्मनः॥
en: The ascetic said A holy and great ascetic had been insulted by your son. He had done it through ill luck, actuated by his foolish understanding.

sa: आपस्तस्तम्भिरे चास्य समुद्रमभियास्यतः। पर्वताश्च ददुर्मार्ग ध्वजभङ्गश्च नाभवत्॥
en: When he went to the sea, the waters used to be turned solid. The mountains gave him way and his standard was never obstructed any where.

sa: ततस्तदस्त्रं सहसा सृष्टं गाण्डीवधन्वना। प्रजज्वाल महार्चिष्मद् युगान्तानलसंनिभम्॥
en: Quickly discharged by the wider of Gandiva, that weapon blazed up with fierce flames like the all-destroying fire that appears at the end of a cycle.

sa: गजाश्वदेहास्थिचयैः पर्वतैरिव संचितम्। नरशीर्षकपालैश्च शङ्कुरिव च सर्वशः॥
en: It also contained many hills made of the bodies and bones of elephants and horses, and human heads and skulls were scattered over it like conch-shells.

sa: अस्य चापग्रहेणैव पाणिः कृतकिणो महान्। कथञ्चिच्छिद्यते गृधेरत्तुकामैस्तलत्रवान्॥
en: His broad palm, covered with leathern fence, and scarred by constant holding of the bow, is pierced with difficulty by vultures desirous of eating it up.

sa: पुत्रं रुधिरसंसिक्तमुपजिघ्रत्यनिन्दिता। दुर्योधनं तु वामोरू: पाणिना परिमार्जती॥
en: Alas, that innocent lady now smells her son covered with blood. Again, that lady having beautiful thighs is gently rubbing Duryodhana's body with her fair hand.

sa: अप्याहुः सर्वमेवेति भूयोऽर्धमिति निश्चयः। कर्मणः पृथिवीपाल नृशंसोऽनृतवागपि॥
en: Some say that the king earns a half, and some say the full measure, of whatever sin is caused by his becoming cruel and a liar.

sa: अवाप्यान् कामयन्नर्थान् नानवाप्यान् कदाचन प्रत्युत्पन्नाननुभवनं मा शुचस्त्वमनागतान्॥
en: Wishing to possess only that which is obtainable and not what is unobtainable, do you enjoy your present belongings and never grieve for what is absent.

sa: तेषामन्यतमोद्रेके विधानमुपदिश्यते। उष्णेन बाध्यते शीतं शीतेनोष्णं प्रबाध्यते॥
en: In case of one of the three prevailing over the rest, remedies have been prescribed. Cold is checked by heat, and heat is checked by cold.

sa: अक्रुध्यत रणे भीमस्तैस्तदा पर्यवस्थितैः। शोऽवथीर्य रथात्तर्ण गदापाणिरयुध्यत॥
en: Thereat Bhima was worked up with anger. Coming down from his car with a mace in his hand he fought with those warriors standing for battle.

sa: के त्वां युधि पराक्रान्तं कालान्तकयमोपमम्। दृष्ट्वा विक्रमसम्पन्नं विद्रविष्यन्ति संयुगे॥ केषां वैवस्वतो राजा स्मरतेऽद्य महाभुज।
en: Who are they that will fly away from the field of battle beholding you endowed with such prowess, resembling the Destroyer himself as he appears at the end of the Yuga and putting forth that prowess of yours? O you of mighty arms who are they whoin king Vaivasvat, has remembered today?

sa: भीष्मं भागीरथीपुत्रं प्रतपन्तं रणे रिपून्॥ ततस्तम्य च तेषां च युद्धे देवासुरोपमे। किरीटीभीष्ममागच्छत् पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्॥
en: That single-handed son of Bhagirathi, viz., Bhishma, who was then scorching the foe in battle. Then in that battle between Bhishma on one side and all the Pandava heroes on the other-battle that resembled the one between the gods and the Asuras-Kiritin placing Shikhandin in front of him began to pierce Bhishma,

sa: रथमास्थाय रुचिरं राजतं पाण्डुरैर्हयैः। सूपस्करं स्वधिष्ठानं वैयाघ्रपरिवारणम्॥
en: I mounted a beautiful chariot made of silver and drawn by white horses, beautiful to look at, furnished with good seats, and covered with tiger skins.

sa: त्यक्त्वानुविन्दोऽथ रथं विन्दस्य रथमास्थितः। धनुर्गृहीत्वा परमं भारसाधनमुत्तमम्॥
en: Thereupon Anuvinda leaving his own car, ascended that of Vinda; thereafter he grasped an excellent bow of great toughness and capable of bearing a great strain.

sa: गुणादाने विप्रयोगे च तेषां मनः सदा बुद्धिपरावराभ्याम्। अनेनैव विधिना सम्प्रवृत्तो गुणापाये ब्रह्म शरीर मेति॥
en: When all earthly objects are destroyed, the mind always attains to That which is higher than the Understanding; while upon their separation the mind always acquires that which is below the Understanding. Therefore, a person, who, according to the method already described, becomes engaged in destroying carthly objects, becomes immersed in Brahma.

sa: अथाब्रवीद् बको दालभ्योधर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्। सध्यां कौन्तेयमासीनमृषिभिः परिवारितम्॥
en: Thereupon one evening (the Rishi) Baka of the Dalvya family addressed the son of Kunti, the pious king Yudhishthira seated in the midst of the Rishis.

sa: शतधा भिन्नदेहास्ते क्षीणप्रहरणौजसः। ततो निवातकवचा मामयुध्यन्त मायया॥
en: Their bodies were cut to a hundred pieces and their weapons lost their energy. Then those Nivatakavachas began fighting with me by the help of illusion.

sa: यौधिष्ठिरिध्वजं तस्य छित्त्वा भूमावपातयत्। नाकुलिश्चाथ यन्तारं रथनीडादपाहरत्॥
en: The son of Yudhishthira felled his standard having at first cut it off, so also Nakula's son felled his charioteer from its place on the chariot.

sa: अथापरेण भल्लेन कुण्डधारं महारथम्। प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Then the former, with another broad headed shaft, dispatched the mighty car-warrior Kundadhara to the region of Dead even before the very eyes of the troops.

sa: नदीनिलयनाः सर्पा नदीकुटिलगामिनः। तिष्ठन्त्यावृत्य पन्थानमतो दुःखतरं वनम्॥
en: And snakes living in the rivers and of crooked course like them, always await the wayfarers, hindering the passers-by: so the wood is full of misery.

sa: कृतकृत्यो वयोऽतीतो राज्ञः कृतपरिश्रमः। वैश्यो गच्छदनुज्ञातो नृपेणाश्रमसंश्रयम्॥
en: Having performed the duties of his order, and having also served the king, an aged Vaisya with the king's permission, may adopt another mode of life.

sa: विकृष्य कार्मुकं घोरं भारसाधनमुत्तमम्। अलम्बुषं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरर्दयामास सर्वतः॥
en: Stretched his dreadful and excellent bow capable of bearing a great strain and then he wounded Alambusha on all parts of his body with sharp shafts

sa: तमिन्द्रं ब्रह्महत्याशु गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति। अपतच्चास्य गात्रेषु तमिन्द्रं दुःखमाविशत्॥
en: And the sin, consequent upon the destruction of a Brahmana, pursuing him vehemently, entered into his person. In this wise Indra became subject to dreadful afflictions.

sa: अग्निशालां प्रविश्याथ पीत्वापः परिमृज्य च। आतिथ्यस्य क्रियाहेतोर्विश्वकर्माणमाह्वयत्॥
en: Then entering the chamber of the sacrificial fire, (Bharadvāja) having sipped water and rubbed his lips therewith, invoked Viśvakarmā for the purpose of entertaining his guest.

sa: धनुः प्रपड्य वामेन करेणामित्रकर्शनः। शिरश्चिच्छेद समरे शरेणानतपर्वणा॥
en: Then that grinder of foes (Bhima) pressing his bow with his left hand, with a straight knotted shaft cut off in that battle, the head of,

sa: मुक्ताहारवृताश्चान्याः काश्चित् प्रसस्तवाससः। व्याविद्धरशनादामाः किशोर्य इव वाहिताः॥
en: And others had their pearl necklaces burst, and their cloths getting away (from their persons), and the chains of their zones straying irregularly; resembling way-worn mares.

sa: पाणिभिश्च कशाभिश्च ताडयन्तस्तुरङ्गमान्॥ जवमुत्तममास्थाय सर्वतः प्राद्रवन् भयात्।
en: And fled away, urging, their steeds to the top of their speed, with their whips, goads & c out of great fear that then overwhelmed them.

sa: मातापितृसहस्राणि पुत्रदारशतानि च। संसारेष्वनुभूतानि यान्ति यास्यन्ति चापरे॥
en: Thousands of mothers, and fathers, and hundreds of sons and wives arise in the world and depart from it. Others will arise and similarly go away.

sa: हयान् द्विपांस्त्वरयन्तो योधा जग्मुः समन्ततः। आत्मत्राणकृतोत्साहास्तावका भरतर्षभ॥
en: Driving their horses and elephants to a great speed, thousands of warriors fled away O foremost of Bharata's race, anxious to secure their personal safety only.

sa: देवासुरमनुष्याणां गन्धर्वोरंगरक्षसाम्। यमेकं जेतुमिच्छेथाः सोऽन्या न भविष्यति॥
en: "Among the celestials, the Asuras, the Gandharvas, the Nagas and the Rakshasas, whoever you will desire to conquer he will certainly be killed by this weapon.

sa: देवदविजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्। ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते॥
en: Reverence to Celestial, regenerate ones, preceptors, and learned men, and purity, uprightness, the practices of a Brahmachary, and abstention from injury, constitute the penance of body.

sa: आशयन्त्यपि मामन्नं पुनर्बहुगुणं बहु। पुनरल्पं पुन:स्तोकं पुनर्नवोपपद्यते॥
en: Sometimes people feed me with luxurious edibles in profusion, sometimes with a small quantity, sometimes even with less, and sometimes I get no food at all.

sa: अधः श्रोत्रेन्द्रियग्राम उत्पद्यति नराधिप। सप्तमं सर्गमित्याहुरेतदैन्द्रियकं स्मृतम्॥
en: The senses that come after the Ear and the others then originate, O king. This is called seventh creation and relates to the senses of knowledge.

sa: स शरक्षयमासाद्य दुःखशोकसमाहतः। धनुष्कोट्या तदा दस्यूनवधीत् पाकशासनिः॥
en: Finding his arrows exhausted, he became deeply afflicted with grief. The son of Indra then began to strike the robbers with the horns of his bow.

sa: दृष्ट्वा रथस्थांस्ताशूरान् सूर्याग्निसमतेजसः। सर्वानेव महेष्वासान् भ्राजमानाश्रिया वृतान्॥
en: Beholding those warriors on that chariots resemble the sun or the fire itself in effulgence, beholding all those fierce bow-men of burning effulgence and exceeding beauty,

sa: अनुतर्षुल एवार्थः स्वादु गाङ्गमिवोदकम्। मद्विलापनमेतत्तु प्रतिबुद्धोऽस्मि संत्यज॥
en: Like the sweet water of the Ganges, riches only enhances one's hankering. It is my destruction. I am now awakened. Do you, O desire, leave me.

sa: दृष्टवा सुमहदाश्चर्यमात्मनो विजयावहम्। यदृच्छयाऽऽगतं व्यासं पप्रच्छ भरतर्षभ॥
en: Beholding a wonderful sight indicative of his victory, questioned, O foremost of the Bharatas, the mighty sage Vyasa who had gone there at his own pleasure.

sa: विषमं पर्वतस्रस्तैरश्मभिश्च समावृतम्। निर्जलं निर्मनुष्यं च बहुयोजनमायतम्॥
en: Its soil was uneven and covered with blocks of stone, loosened from the hills. There were no water and human habitations; it extended to many yojanas.

sa: संहिताध्ययने युक्तौ गोत्रतश्चापि काश्यपौ। तारणेयौ युक्तरूपौ ब्राह्मणावृषिसत्तमौ॥
en: They belonged to the race of Kashyapa and they were engaged in studying the Institutes. Those two Brahmana Rishi were quite capable of helping the king.

sa: स आश्रमपदद्वारि वृक्षमूले महातपाः। ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्महायोगी तस्थौ मौनव्रतान्वितः॥
en: The great ascetic sat at the entrance of his hermitage, as a great Yogi with his arms upraised in the observance of the vow of silence.

sa: महासुरस्यान्ववाये हिरण्यकशिपोः पुरा। निकुम्भो नाम दैत्येन्द्रस्तेजस्वी बलवानभूत्॥
en: In the days of yore there was a Danava chief, named Nikumbha, who was energetic and strong and who was born in the race of Hiranyakashipu.

sa: अप्रमत्तोत्थिताः :क्षान्ताः प्रतपन्तोऽहितान्बहून्। अजयद्भीमसेनस्तु दिशं प्राची महायशाः॥
en: Being unexcited by wrath, being calm in demeanour and putting down numerous evils, the Pandavas gradually rose in power. The greatly illustrious Bhima subjugated the East.

sa: दानवा राक्षसाश्चैव गन्धर्वाः पन्नगास्तथा। न तान्बलस्थान्बाल्येऽपि जघ्नुर्भरतसत्तम॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the Danavas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas and Nagas could not kill the (incarnate) celestials, even in their infancy, so strong were they.

sa: तत्रोपविष्टं वरदं देवर्षिगणपूजितम्। पूजयामास राजेन्द्रः शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: When the boon-granting and the adored of the celestials, the Rishis (Vyasa) took his seat, the king of kings (Janamejaya) worshipped him according to the ordinances.

sa: अहं गङ्गा जह्वसुता महर्षिगणसेविता। देवकार्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमुषिताहं त्वया सह॥
en: I am Ganga, the daughter of Jahnu, worshipped by all great Rishis. I have so long lived with your for accomplishing the purpose of the celestials.

sa: स्कन्धः शक्तिं समादाय तस्थौ पेरुरिवाचलः। ओषधीर्दीप्यमानाश्च जगृहातेऽश्विनावपि॥
en: Skanda (Kartikeya) took up his weapon Shakti and he stood as motionless as Meru mountain. The Ashvinis stood up with their fiery plaints in there hands.

sa: ततो व्यपोहमानास्ते पाण्डवार्थे हुताशनम्। निषादी ददृशुर्दग्धां पञ्चपुत्रामनागसम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: They then began to extinguish the fire to find out the Pandavas. They saw the Nishada woman burnt to death with her five sons.

sa: अस्याज्ञावशगाः सर्वे भविष्यन्ति नराधिपाः। सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्य वायोरिव शरीरिणः॥
en: All the kings will remain obedient to him, as all embodied beings remain obedient to the wind, which is as dear to beings as the self.

sa: स चाश्विरूपसदृशो देवतुल्यपराक्रमः। सर्वासामेव नारीणां चित्तप्रमथनो रहः॥
en: He (Vichitravirya) too, endued as he was with the beauty of the Ashvinis and the prowess of the celestials, could steal the hearts of all women.

sa: तच्छैलशृङ्गप्रतिमं दानवस्य शिरो महत्। चक्रच्छिन्नं खमुत्पत्य ननादातिभयंकरम्॥
en: The huge head of the Danava cut off by the discus, appeared like a mountain peak and it rose to the sky and uttered terrible cries.

sa: साब्रवीत्पश्य भगवन्पारावारे स्थितानृषीन्। आवयोर्दृष्टयोरेभिः कथं तु स्यात्समागमः॥
en: She replied, "O holy Rishi, see, the Rishis are standing on both the banks of the river. Seen by them, how can I grant your wish?"

sa: तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ बलिनौ वासितान्तरे। अन्योन्यमभ्यवर्तेतां बलविक्रमशालिनौ॥
en: The two (heroes) then began to show their prowess on each other like two roaring bulls of great strength fighting at the sight of a cow.

sa: पूर्वेन्द्रा ऊचुः गमिष्यामो मानुषं देवलोकाद् दुराधरो विहितो यत्र मोक्षः। देवास्त्वस्मानादधीरञ्जनन्यां धर्मो वायुर्मघावानश्विनौ च। अस्त्रैर्दिव्यैर्मानुषान् योधयित्वा आगन्तारः पुनरेवेन्द्रलोकम्॥
en: The Old Indras said : We shall go from our celestial region to the region of men where salvation is difficult to gain. But let the celestials, Dharma, Vayu, Maghavata (present Indra) and the twin Ashvinis beget us on our would be mother. After fighting with men with both hunian and celestial weapons, we shall again come back to the region of Indra.

sa: कन्यागर्भः पृथुयशाः पृथायाः पृथुलोचनः। तीक्ष्णांशो स्करस्यांशः कर्णोऽरिगणसूदनः॥
en: The illustrious destroyer of enemies, the large eyed Karna was born of Pritha (Kunti) in her maidenhood. He was a portion of the hot beamed sun.

sa: वर्चस्विनां ब्राह्मणानां स्नातकानां परिच्छदम्। आच्छाद्य सुहृदां वाक्यैर्मनोहरभिनन्दिताः॥
en: They were attired in the grab of Snataka Brahmanas of effulgent bodies; they were blessed by the agreeable speeches of friends and relatives, (when they started).

sa: यदा विबुद्धः कौन्तेयस्तदा संच्छिद्य बन्धनम्। उदतिष्ठन्महाबाहुर्भीमसेनो गतव्यथः॥
en: But when the strong-armed Bhima, the son of Kunti, awoke, he tore up the strings with which he was bound and his pains were all gone.

sa: ईजिरे च महायज्ञैः क्षत्रिया बहुदक्षिणैः। साङ्गोपनिषदान्वेदान्विप्राश्चाधीयते तदा।॥
en: The Kshatriyas performed great sacrifices and bestowed much wealth on the Brahmanas and all the Brahmanas also studied the Vedas and the Vedangas and the Upanishads.

sa: तत्राभिषेकं कृत्वा स तर्पयित्वा पितामहान्। उत्तितीर्घर्जलाद् राजन्नग्निकार्यचिकीर्षया॥ अपकृष्टो महाबाहुर्नागराजस्य कन्यया। अन्तर्जले महाराज उलूप्या कामयानया॥
en: O king, performing his ablutions and offering water to the grandsires, as he was getting out of the water with the desire of performing his sacrificial rites before the fire. O great king the mighty-armed hero was dragged into water by the daughter of the Naga king, named Ulupi, maddened with desire.

sa: बाघेतामानुषः शत्रुर्यदि त्वां वीर कश्चन। तद्वधाय प्रयुञ्जीथास्तदस्त्रमिदमाहवे॥
en: O hero, if ever any foe, if he is not human, comes to fight with you, may then use it against him to accomplish his death."

sa: द्विजप्रभावाद्राजेन्द्र व्यजीवत्स वनस्पतिः। तेनागम्य द्विजश्रेष्ठ पुंसाऽस्मासु निवेदितम्॥
en: O king of kings, he was revived with the tree by the power of the Brahmana. That man, a servant of a Brahmana, came to us,

sa: संसिक्तमृष्टपन्थानं पताकाध्वजशोभितम्। मनः प्रह्लादयामास तस्य तत् पुरमुत्तमम्॥
en: His (king's) mind was filled with joy on seeing that excellent city with its well-watered and well-swept streets and with banners and pendants flying all around.

sa: राज्ञस्तु भवनद्वारि सोऽवतीर्य नरोत्तमः। अवाङ्मुखो दीनमनाः प्रविवेशानिवारितः॥
en: Having descended from his car at the palacegate, Laksmana, the foremost of men, with his face down wards and a distressed heart, unobstructed, entered the palace.

sa: व्यवसायसहायस्य विष्णोः शत्रुवधेष्विव। पार्थायाग्निर्ददौ चापि गाण्डीवं धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: As nothing is a heavy task to Vishnu, in the matter of destroying his enemies. Agni gave to the son of Pritha the excellent bow Gandiva.

sa: दुर्लभस्त्वीदृशो बन्धुरस्मिन्काले विशेषतः। यादृशस्त्वं महाबुद्धिर्मम सौम्य मनोऽनुगः॥
en: O you having an auspicious look, you are gifted with great intellect and after my heart; a friend like you is rare at such a time.

sa: ब्रह्मर्षिणा व्रतवता वर्षाणां शतमत्रिणा। अनासादितगाधं च पातालतलमव्ययम्॥
en: The Rishi Atri of great austerity could not fathom its bottom, lower than the nether regions, though he tried to do it for one hundred years.

sa: पूर्ण वर्षसहस्रं मे विषयासक्तचेतसः। तथाप्यनुदिनं तृष्णा ममैतेष्वभिजायते॥
en: My mind was attached to the pleasures of life for full one thousand years. My thirst for them, however, without being abated, is daily being increased.

sa: घोरास्तस्यास्त्रयः पुत्राः पापकर्मरताः सदा। भयो महाभयश्चैव मृत्युर्भूतान्तकस्तथा॥
en: She had also three other fearful and cruel sons, always engaged in sinful deeds. (They were) Bhaya, Mahabhaya and Mrityu, the destroyer of every created thing.

sa: पुण्यतीर्थानुसंयानं बभ्रुवाहनजन्म च। तत्रैव मोक्षयामास पञ्चसोऽप्सरसः शुभाः॥
en: It then describes the birth of Babhruvahana; and the account of Arjuna's visit to many holy pilgrimages; the deliverance by Arjuna of the five celestial maidens.

sa: अङ्गराज्यं च नार्हस्त्वमुपभोक्तुं नराधम। श्वा हुताशमीपस्थं पुरोडाशमिवाध्वरे॥
en: O worst of men, you are not worthy of enjoying the kingdom of Anga, as a dog deserves not the ghee placed before the sacrificial fire."

sa: तस्यास्तीरे भगवतः काश्यपस्य महात्मनः। आश्रमप्रवरं रम्यं महर्षिगणसेवितम्॥
en: On the banks of that river, stood the excellent and charming hermitage of the illustrious Rishi, (the descendant of) Kashyapa, frequented by many great ascetic Rishis.

sa: तृतीयस्तु महातेजा महामायो महासुरः। निषादाधिपतिर्जज्ञे भुवि भीमपराक्रमः॥
en: The third was a great Asura, endued with great prowess and power of deception, (Magical powers) and he became the greatly powerful king of the Nishadas.

sa: शक्तिं शक्रो ददौ तस्मै विस्मितश्चेदमब्रवीत्। देवासुरमनुष्याणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्॥
en: Indra, who being much surprised (for his liberality), presented him with a dart and spoke to him thus, "The Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, Rakshasas, Uragas or men,

sa: ततोऽम्बराच्चिन्तितमात्रमागतं महाप्रभं चक्रममित्रतापनम्। विभावसोस्तुल्यमकुण्ठमण्डलं सुदर्शनं संयति भीमदर्शनम्॥
en: As soon as it was thought of the discus Sudarshana, the destroyer of enemies, effulgent as Agni and dreadful in battle, came down from the sky.

sa: प्रवृद्धविटपैर्वृक्षः सुखच्छायैः समावृतम्। षट्पदाघूर्णिततलं लक्ष्म्या परमया युतम्॥
en: It contained magnificent trees withstretched out branches, which had formed pleasant shady canopies. The bees hovered over the flowery creepers and beautiful groves were every where.

sa: ततोऽशनिमुचो घोरांस्तडित्स्तनितनि:स्वनान्। तद्विघातार्थमसृजदर्जुनोऽप्यस्त्रमुत्तमम्॥ वायव्यमभिमन्याथ प्रतिपत्तिविशारदः। तेनेन्द्राशनिमेघानां वीर्योजस्तद् विनाशितम्॥ जलधाराश्च ताः शोषं जग्मुर्नेशुश्च विद्युतः। क्षणेन चाभवद् व्योम समप्रशान्तरजस्तमः॥
en: Thereupon those clouds, charged with thunder-rattle, vomited thunder and flashes of lightings; but to dispel them Arjuna hurled and excellent weapon. Named Vayavya (wind weapon) with proper Mantras. In a moment it destroyed the force and the energy of Indra's thunder and it dried up the water that was in those masses of clouds; it then destroyed the lightings that played amongst them.

sa: तत्र सौबलकाः क्रुद्धा वार्ष्णेयस्य रथोत्तमम्। तिलशश्चिच्छिदुः क्रोधाच्छस्त्रैर्नानाविधैर्युधि॥
en: Then those brave warriors led by Subala's son angrily cut down into fragments the excellent car of the Vrishni hero (Satyaki) with various kinds of weapons.

sa: स मुमोच महेष्वासः शरसंघाननेकशः॥ निजन्नमित्रान् समरे वज्रपाणिरिवासुरान्।
en: That great bow man shot showers in arrows and struck down his enemies in that battle as Vishnu, arıncd with the discus struck down the Asuras.

sa: प्रासानुत्कृय तरसा स्वशरीरादरिंदमः। तैरेव ताडयमास सुबलस्यात्मजान् रणे॥
en: Then drawing out all those lances from his own body, that subduer of enemies wounded the sons of Subala in battle even with those very lances.

sa: यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं यथासत्त्वं नराधिपाः। वारयध्वं यथायोगं पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: "O rulers of men, do you check the Pandava host, according to your strength energy and prowess and according to the opportunities that may present themselves."

sa: सौमदत्तिरुरःस्थास्तै शं बाणैरशोभत। मध्यंदिने महाराज रश्मिभिस्तपनो यथा॥
en: The son of Somadatta, O mighty monarch, with those arrows struck on his breast, appeared highly beautiful like the midday sun covered with its own rays.

sa: ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः। यज्ज्ञान्चा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते॥
en: I shall now tell you exhaustively about Knowledge together with science (experience) knowing which there will remain nothing more (for you) in this world to know.

sa: वार्यमाणाः सुबहुशस्वैगर्तेन सुशर्मणा। तथान्यैः पार्थिवश्रेष्ठैर्न व्यतिष्ठन्त संयुगे॥
en: Through they were repeatedly forbidden by the Trigarta ruler Susharma as also by many other foremost sovereigns they did not tarry on the field any longer.

sa: भूमिरापस्तथा वायुरग्निराकाशमेव च। गुणोत्तराणि सर्वाणि तेषां भूमिः प्रधानतः॥ शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धश्च पञ्चमः। प्रोक्ता ऋषिभिस्तत्त्ववेदिभिः॥
en: These elements are the ether, air, fire, water, and earth. Their attributes are sound, touch, vision, taste and smell. Every one of these elements possesses the attributes and the attributes of things that come to it. Therefore the earth is the foremost of all, possessing as it does the attributes of all the other four. Thus say the Rishis who know the truth.

sa: तस्य द्रोणोऽच्छिनन्मुष्टौ खङ्गं मणिमयत्सरुम्॥ क्षुरप्रेण महातेजास्त्वरमाणः सपत्नजित्।
en: Then that conqueror of enemies, viz., Drona of mighty energy quickly cut-off the jeweldecked hilt of Abhimanyu's sword with a single shaft furnished with a horse-shoe-head.

sa: समितिधर्मराजस्य सा पार्थिवसमाकुला। शुशुभे तारकैश्चित्रा द्यौश्चन्द्रेणेव भारत॥
en: The assembly, of the virtuous king with all the rulers of the earth, shone as the moon in the sky surrounded by diverse stars, O Bharata.

sa: पुत्रस्नेहान्महाबाहुः सुखं पर्यचरत् तदा। सर्वानभिप्रायकृतान् भार्याऽलभत कौरव॥
en: The mighty-armed one, on account of his affection for his son, ordered all that was agreeable. And O Kaurava, his wife obtained everything that she desired.

sa: अर्चयित्वा यथान्यायमुपविष्टं युधिष्ठिरः। अब्रवीच्छोकसंतप्तो भ्रातुः पुत्रवधेन च॥
en: Then having duly worshipped him, Yudhishthira resumed his seat; and afflicted with grief at the death of his brother's son, he then thus addressed the Rishi.

sa: दिशो विचरतस्तस्य सर्वाश्च प्रदिशस्तथा। रणेऽभिमन्योः क्रुद्धस्य रूपमन्तरधीयत॥
en: The very form of Abhimanyu could not then be discerned, as he careered through the field of battle moving in all the directions, subsidiary and cardinal.

sa: अन्वासन्त दुराधर्षं देवव्रतमरिंदमम्। अन्योन्यं प्रीतिमन्तस्ते यथापूर्वं यथावयः॥
en: Approached the invincible Devavrata that subduer of foes. Then as in former days, they were friendly to one another, and addressed one another in agreeable words.

sa: यमस्य भवनं देव गच्छेयं न सुरोत्तम॥ कायेन विनयोपेता मोदग्रनखेन च। एतदिच्छाम्यहं कामं त्वत्तो लोकपितामह॥
en: O foremost of the celestials, O Divine Being, I will not go to Yama's abode. O you. that bestow boons, I do propitiate you, by bending my head low and by folding my hands, O Grandsire of the worlds, I desire the fulfillment of even this wish of mine at your hands.

sa: भगदत्तेन समरे काल्यमानेषु पाण्डुषु॥ प्राग्ज्योतिषमभिक्रुद्धः पुनर्भीमः समभ्ययात्।
en: Thus when the Pandavas were being afflicted by Bhagadatta in that battle, Bhima wrought up with wrath once more rushed against the ruler of the Pragjyotisas.

sa: जाम्बूनदमयी वेदी कमण्डलुविभूषिता॥ केतुराचार्यमुख्यस्य द्रोणस्य धनुषा सह।
en: The standard of Drona that foremost of preceptors, note the device of a golden altar, adorned with a water pot and a figure of a bow.

sa: योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयम्। आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनंजय॥
en: Actions, O Dhananjaya, do not fetter him, who is self-possessed, whose doubts have been removed by knowledge and who has placed all his actions in Yoga.

sa: सोऽहं भरतशार्दूल भीमसेनपुरोगमैः। घटोत्कचं समाश्रित्य पाण्डवैर्युधि निर्जितः॥
en: Though thus supported, yet, О foremost of the Bharatas, I have been worsted in battle by the Pandava combatants headed by Bhimasena and dependent on Ghatotkacha.

sa: प्रविष्टो धार्तराष्ट्राणामेतद् बलमहार्णवम्। मामुक्त्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रः प्रीतियुक्तमिदं वचः॥
en: Has, alone and unsupported entered into the ocean like host of the sons of Dhritarashtra. He said to me, O foremost of men, these cheerful words.

sa: मद्रराजरथं प्राप्तं मृत्योरास्यगतं यथा। अभ्यपद्यत संग्रामे युधिष्ठिरममित्रजित्॥
en: Staying within the reach of the Madra king's car, as if within the very jaws of death, rushed in that battle to the side of Yudhishthira.

sa: अथबुद्ध्या समीक्षस्व किन्नु कार्यमनन्तरम्। अर्जुनस्य विघाताय दारुणेऽस्मिञ्जनक्षये॥
en: Now decide with the help of your understanding, what should be done next, for bringing about the slaughter of Arjuna, taking into consideration this fearful carnage.

sa: आसीत् किलकिलाशब्दस्तलशङ्खरवैः सह। जज्ञिरे सिंहनादाश्च शूराणां प्रतिगर्जताम्॥
en: A tremendous uproar was heard mingled with the flapping of the leather and the blare of conchs. Lion-like roars rose from men shouting at one another.

sa: सा पार्थिवशताकीर्णा समितिर्भीष्मशोभिता। शुशुभे भारती दीप्ता दिवीवादित्यमण्डलम्॥
en: Then that assembly crowded with numerous Bharata kings, and ornamented by the presence of Bhishma, appeared beautiful like a conclave of the gods in the heavens.

sa: हिरण्यकवचाः सर्वे सर्वे चोत्तमधन्विनः। सर्वेऽश्वमेधैरीजाना: कुमारा: शशबिन्दवः॥
en: All of them, (on occasions of battle) used to don golden coats of mail; and all were excellent bowmen. All those of Shashabindu accomplished the Horse-sacrifice.

sa: प्रादुश्चक्रेऽस्त्रमत्युग्रं भास्करं कुरुनन्दनः। ततः प्रकाशमभवज्जगत् सर्वं महीपते॥
en: That delighter of the Kuru race, invoked into existence the solar weapon of great effulgence. Then, O monarch, the world was again disclosed to the sight.

sa: गृह्येनमनुपायज्ञा नीत्वारण्यमचेतसः॥ हत्वा विशस्य चापश्यन् लुब्धा वसुन किञ्चन। तस्य प्राणैर्विमुक्तस्य नष्टं तद् वरदं वसु॥
en: Seizing him and carrying him to the woods, lose idiots not knowing what to do with him. (Out of avarice slew him and cut him to pieces. But they found not any gold inside his frame. When that child was deprived of his life, all the gold consequent the sages boon, disappeared.

sa: अद्य पश्यामि पृथिवीं शून्यामिव हतत्विषम्। अभिमन्युमपश्यन्ती शोकव्याकुललोचना॥
en: Today do I see the earth vacant and destitute of its beauty, inasmuch as I do not see Abhimanyu and my eyes are blinded with grief.

sa: वज्रसंहादसंकाशस्त्रासयन् मानवान् बहून्। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे जिष्णुर्जित्वा संशप्तकान् बहून्॥
en: At this juncture, the ever-victorious Arjuna, having vanquished the numerous host of the Samshaptakas, came to the spot where Drona had been crushing the Pandava ranks.

sa: अभिपत्य महाबाहुर्गरुत्मानिव वेगितः। सेनापतेः क्षुरप्रेण शिरश्चिच्छेद पाण्डवः॥
en: Then that mighty-armed son of Pandu, swooping down with great violence like Garuda himself, cut off with a horse shoe headed shaft the head of Senapati.

sa: तमूहर्वाजिनो वश्याः सैन्धवाः साधुवाहिनः। विकुर्वाणा बृहन्तोऽश्वाः श्वसनोपमरंहसः॥
en: Excellent steeds of the Sindhu breed obedient to the behests of the charioteer and fleet as the wind itself, carried him to the field of battle.

sa: महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामसम्येकमक्षरम्। यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः॥
en: I am Bhrigu among the great Rishis, I am Om among all words, I am Tapa Sacrifice among all sacrifices. I am the Himalaya among mountains.

sa: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः। बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः॥
en: Many holy sages, who are freed from attachment, fear and wrath, who are full of Me and who depend upon Me, have attained to my essence.

sa: अलम्बुषं शरैरन्यैरभ्याकिरत सर्वतः। पर्वतं वारिधाराभिः प्रावृषीव बलाहकः॥
en: Poured a shower of dreadful shafts of Alambusha from all sides, like clouds in the rainy season covering the mountain top with (thick showers of rain).

sa: ततः स रुचिपर्वाणं शरेणानतपर्वणा॥ सुपर्वा पर्वतपतिर्निन्ये वैवस्वतक्षयम्।
en: Then that ruler of the mountain tracts possessed of shapely limbs, dispatched, with a straight shaft, Ruchiparvan to the regions of the son of Vivasvan (Death).

sa: पुण्यगन्धान् पद्मपात्रे गन्धर्वाप्सरसोऽदुहन्। वत्सश्चित्ररथस्तेषां दोग्धा विश्वरुचिः प्रभुः॥
en: The Apsaras and the Gandharvas milked her of holy fragrance and received it in lotuspetals. Chitraratha became their calf and the lord Visvaruchi became their milker.

sa: ततस्तद् विततं सैन्यं हस्त्यश्वरथपत्तिमत्। क्रूद्धोऽभिमन्युरभिनत् तिग्मतेजा महारथः॥
en: Then Abhimanyu possessed of fierce energy and great renown, wrought up with rage, began to break through the various division of cars, elephants, steeds and infantry.

sa: पश्यामस्त्वां महाबाहो रथे सूर्यमिवापरम्। रथाश्वनरनागानां हन्तारं परवीरहन्॥
en: O slayer of hostile heroes, slaying as you do, car-warriors, horsemen and elephant-riders, we behold you, O mighty-armed one, as a second sun on the chariot.

sa: तैः किरीटी किरीटस्थैर्हमपुजैरजिह्मगैः। शातकुम्भमयापीडो बभौ सूर्य इवोत्थितः॥
en: Having those straight-going shafts furnished with wings of gold stuck on his diadem, Arjuna, as if adorned with ornaments of gold, shone like the rising Sun.

sa: तावन्योन्यं गदाग्राभ्यामाहत्य पतितौ क्षितौ॥ इन्द्रध्वजाविवोत्सृष्टौ रणमध्ये परंतपौ।
en: Then striking one another by the ends of their clubs, they both fell down on the ground, like two uprooted standards raised in honour of Indra.

sa: लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः। छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः॥
en: The Rishis, whose sins are destroyed, whose misgivings are perished, who are selfrestraint and who are engaged in doing good to all beings, obtain Brahma Nirvana.

sa: अन्योन्यमभिधावन्तः सम्प्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे। व्यतिषक्तं महारौद्रं युद्धं भीरुभयावहम्॥
en: Rushed at one another and then smote down one another. Thus raged the most dreadful combat capable of inspiring terror into the hearts of the cowards.

sa: उत्सृज्य राजानमनन्तवीर्यो जयद्रथादींश्च नृपान् महौजाः॥ ययौ ततो भीमबलौ मनस्वी गाङ्गेयमाजौ शरचापपाणिः। युधिष्ठिरश्च प्रबलो महात्मा समाययौ त्वरितो जातकोपः॥
en: Then that highly powerful and wonderfullyintelligent hero of infinite prowess and great energy, fighting with them for a moment only and checking them, and then avoiding the king (Duryodhana) and Jayadratha and others, proceeded towards the son of Ganga, holding in his hands his bow and his arrows. Then the illustrious Yudhishthira of fierce prowess, excited with wrath speedily rushed to the battle.

sa: विष्वग्वाताश्च विवर्नीचैः शर्करकर्षिणः रजश्योद्भूयत महत् तम आच्छादयज्जगत्॥
en: Dry winds began to blow from all sides, carrying showers of sharp pointed stones and pebbles. A thick dust rose and covered the world with darkness.

sa: सततं कृष्यतः संख्ये धनुषोऽस्याशुकारिणः। जयाघोषः शुश्रुवेऽत्यर्थं विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः॥
en: In that battle, they heard the twang of the constantly stretched bow of that warrior of great activity, twang that resembled the rumbling of the thunder.

sa: रुक्ममालाधराः शूरा हेमपृष्ठाः स्वलंकृताः। काशिराज नरश्रेष्ठं श्लाघनीयमुदावहन्॥
en: The gallant warriors with gold garland around their neck and the well decorated horses with golden back side brought the competitive king Kashiraja to the battle-field.

sa: शोणिताक्ता गदां बिभ्रन्मेदोमज्जाकृतच्छविः। कृताभ्यङ्गः शोणितेन रुद्रवत् प्रत्यदृश्यता॥
en: Wielding his mace bathed in blood, with his person be spattered with fat and marrow, and smeared with gore Bhima appeared beautiful like the Rudra himself.

sa: भगवन्नेवमेवैतद् यथाऽऽहं भगवांस्तथा। अजेयो युधि भीष्मोऽयमपि देवरुदारधीः॥
en: "O holy one, it is even as your holy self has said. This Bhishma, of varied intelligence, is invincible in battle even by the very gods.

sa: पितामहो हि कुशलः परेषामात्मनस्तथा। श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं सर्वैः सहैभिर्वसुधाधिपैः॥
en: Our grandfather is familiar with ourselves as also with our enemies and I desire to hear all about it, along with these rulers of the earth.

sa: बलिनौ युद्धदुर्धर्षावन्योन्यसदृशावुभौ। चिह्नमात्रेण भीष्मं तु प्रजजुस्तत्र कौरवाः॥
en: Both of them possessed great prowess and great courage in battle. Each was other's match. Seeing his (Bhishma's) standard alone, the Kurus could come near him.

sa: दशमेऽहनि तस्मिंस्तु भीष्मार्जुनसमागमे। अवर्तत महारौद्रः सततं समितिक्षयः॥
en: Then in that battle on the tenth day when Bhishma and Arjuna confronted one another, the carnage that was caused was indeed terrible to the extreme.

sa: पतद्भिश्च महाराज शिरोभिर्धरणीतले। बभूव तुमुलः शब्दः पततामश्मनामिव॥
en: As those heads, O mighty monarch, fell down on the surface of the earth, a great noise was produced like that of a shower of stones.

sa: द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्। जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्व सत्ववतामहम्॥
en: I am the dice-game among cheats, I am the glory among the glories. I am victory, I am industry, I am the goodness of the good.

sa: अर्थी येनार्थकृत्येन संव्रजत्यविचारयन्। तमर्थमर्थशास्त्रज्ञाः प्राहुरर्थ्याः सुलक्ष्मण ॥
en: The object which persons desirous of acquiring wealth follow without any discretion in their actions, is the true definition of wealth given by the political economists.

sa: एष शोकः परित्यक्तः सर्वकार्यावसादकः। विक्रमेष्वप्रतिहतं तेजः प्रोत्साहयाम्यहम्॥
en: Renouncing this grief standing in the way of all business, I shail call forth, the more, this my energy on the occasion of displaying my prowess.

sa: आज्ञाप्य तु महाराजो राघवस्याभिषेचनम्॥ उपस्थानमनुज्ञाप्य प्रविवेश निवेशनम्।
en: The monarch having issued orders for the installation of Rāma, entered his inner apartment after giving permission to the courtiers to repair to their respective abodes.

sa: ततः सभार्ये भयमोहमूच्छिता सलक्ष्मणं राघवमागतं वनम्। विरूपणं चात्मनि शोणितोक्षिता शशंस सर्वं भगिनी खरस्य सा॥
en: Then that sister of Khara, bathed in blood, and deprived of her senses through fright, related all about Räma's arrival at the forest along with Lakşmaņa and his own wife, as well as the forest along with Lakşmana and his own wife, as well as the circumstances connected with her being deformed.

sa: सास्म्यगाधे भये मग्ना दुःखशोकसमन्विता। दह्यमानानलेनेव त्वद्धितार्थमिहागता ॥
en: I have been sunk in a fathomless fear; and afflicted with grief and heaviness. And as if burning I, seeking your welfare, have come to you.

sa: प्रणष्टदुःखसंकल्पा हर्षविद्योतितानना। द्रक्ष्यामि त्वां वनात् प्राप्तं पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम्॥
en: Myself having sorrows removed and having my face glowing with joy, shall see you coming from the forest like to the rising of the full moon.

sa: निष्क्रान्तमात्रे भवति सहसीते सलक्ष्मणे। दुःखशोकाभिभूतस्तु राजा त्रिदिवमभ्यगात्॥
en: As soon as you had set out (for the forest) along with Sītā and Lakşmaņa, the king borne down by grief and chagrin, went to heaven.

sa: सुखोषितोऽस्मि भगवन् समग्रबलवाहनः। बलवत्तर्पितश्चाहं बलवान् भगवंस्त्वया॥ अपेतक्लमसंतापाः सुभिक्षाः सुप्रतिश्रयाः। अपि प्रेष्यानुपादाय सर्वे स्म सुसुखोषिताः॥
en: O reverend Sire, I along with all my forces and vehicles have passed (the night) happily. I have been full well entertained by you, o worshipful one possessed of power. And with our languor and heat removed, all sumptuously feasted and comfortably quartered, have passed (the night) agreeably along with our servants.

sa: अर्घ्यं पाद्यं तथाऽऽतिथ्यं निवेद्य कुशिकात्मजे॥ रामलक्ष्मणयोः पश्चादकुर्वनतिथिक्रियाम्।
en: Then giving Kusika's son water to wash his feet and Arghya, and extending to him also the rites of hospitality, they next entertained Rāma and Laksmana.

sa: प्रकृत्या निपुणश्चैव बुद्धिमांश्चैव वानरः। नापरीक्षितवीर्येण सुग्रीवः सख्यमेष्यति॥
en: That monkey is clever by nature and gifted with intellect. And Sugrīva shall not desire friendship with any one without having a test of his prowess.

sa: सधूमशोणितोद्गारी रामबाणाभिपीडितः॥ न्यपतत् पतितैः पूर्वं समरस्थो निशाचरः।
en: And that ranger of the night present in the field, afflicted by the shafts of Rāma, after his heads had fallen first, fell, vomiting smoking gore.

sa: तप्यमानो तदा देवे सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः। सेनापतिमभीप्सन्तः पितामहमुपागमन्॥
en: On that celestial being engaged in austerities, the deities with Indra and Agni at their head, desirous of gaining over the generalissimo, Appeared before the Grand-sire.

sa: पुष्पनद्धां वसन्तान्ते मत्तभ्रमरशालिनीम्। द्रुतदावाग्निविप्लुष्टां क्लान्तां वनलतामिव ॥
en: Like a blossoming creeper at the end of spring with maddened Bhramaras* suddenly rendered nerveless in consequence of being caught by a forest fire. *Black bees.

sa: तस्याः स्फटिकसंकाशं वारि संतापसम्भवम्। नेत्राभ्यां परिसुस्राव पङ्कजाभ्यामिवोदकम्॥
en: Tears caused by her sorrow and white as the crystal began to trickle down from her eyes, like to water falling in drops from lotus petals.

sa: ये तत्र चित्रकूटस्य पुरस्तात् तापसाश्रमे। राममाश्रित्य निरतास्तानलक्षयदुत्सुकान्॥
en: And those ascetic that were living happily in the asylum in Citrakuța, relying upon Rāma (for their protection), he found to be wrought up with anxiety.

sa: बलवान् निहतामित्रो मित्रवान् विजितेन्द्रियः। धनैश्च संचयैश्चान्यैः शक्रवैश्रवणोपमः॥
en: He possessed of strength, the destroyer of foes, having friends, of subdued senses, comparable to ſakra and Vaiśravaņa by virtue of accumulated riches and other possessions.

sa: नयनैर्धकुटीभिश्च रामं निर्दिश्य शङ्किताः। अन्योन्यमुपजल्पन्तः शनैश्चक्रुर्मिथः कथाः॥
en: And by means of signs by the eye and contractions of the brow, they, afflicted with fear, were, alluding to Răma, slowly speaking to each other.

sa: मया समेतोऽरण्यानि रम्याणि विचरिष्यसि। पक्षिभिर्भूङ्गयूथैश्च संघुष्टानि समन्ततः॥
en: You shall range with me in that charming pare of the forest which resounds with the music of the birds and the humming of the bees.

sa: न नूनं बुध्यसे रामं महावीर्यगुणोन्नतम्। अयुक्तचारश्चपलो महेन्द्रवरुणोपमम्॥
en: Volatile, and employing no spies, you surely do not understand the exceedingly powerful Rāma towering high in virtues, and resembling the illustrious Indra or Varuņa himself.

sa: भ्रातृणां त्वरितास्ते तु द्रष्टुकामाः समागमम्। ययुर्बहुविधैर्यानैः खुरनेमिसमाकुलैः॥
en: And desirous of witnessing the meeting of the brothers (with Rāma), they with all despatch proceeded by means of various vehicles consisting of beasts and cars.

sa: तस्मिन् प्लवगशार्दूले प्लवमाने हनूमति। इक्ष्वाकुकुलमानार्थी चिन्तयामास सागरः॥
en: Hanumān, that lord of monkeys, being engaged in the act of bounding, the Ocean, who sought to do honour to the race of Ikşvāku within himself.

sa: ऋषयस्तुष्टुवुश्चैनं प्लवमानं विहायसा। जगुश्च देवगन्धर्वाः प्रशंसन्तो वनौकसम्॥
en: And the saints hymned his praises, as he was leaping on in the sky. And applauding the ranger of forests, they raised the voice of song.

sa: अनुरूपः स वो नाथो लक्ष्मीवॉल्लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। त्रैलोक्यमपि नाथेन येन स्यानाथवत्तरम् ॥ अनेन श्रेयसा सद्यः संयोक्ष्येऽहमिमां महीम्। गतक्लेशो भविष्यामि सुते तस्मिन् निवेश्य वै॥
en: And that auspicious elder brother of Laksmana* will make a fit ruler for you, yea, the very three worlds might consider themselves as having a lord, by possessing him, through his agency I shall this day bring about the welfare of the world; and shall renounce my toil by reposing in him the task of government. *There is an alliterative beauty here in the original: Laksmīvān Laksmanāgraja; which of course is impossible to be retained in the translation.

sa: ततस्तामापगां दिव्यां प्रसन्नसलिलाशयाम्॥ तत्र द्रक्ष्यथ कावेरी विहतामप्सरोगणैः।
en: At the foot of the Malaya mountain endued with exceeding energy, you will behold the noble stream Kāveri, of pleasant waters, where sport troops of Apsarās.

sa: तिष्ठन्तु सर्वदाशाश्च गङ्गामन्वाश्रिता नदीम्। बलयुक्ता नदीरक्षा मांसमूलफलाशनाः॥
en: And stationed on the river Gangā, let my powerful retainers subsisting on fruits and roots and meat, be prepared for opposing Bharata's passages over the river.

sa: एष त्विदानीमेवाहमप्रियार्थं तवानघे। निवर्तयिष्यामि वनाद् भ्रातरं स्वजनप्रियम्॥
en: Further, O sinless one, I will do this at present was to displease you: I will bring from the forest my brother dear to his relatives.

sa: तस्य वेगप्रविद्धस्य वक्त्रात् क्षतजबिन्दवः। प्रपेतुर्मारुतोत्क्षिप्ता मतङ्गस्याश्रमं प्रति॥
en: While thus thrown down by force, drops of blood, falling from his mouth, driven by the wind, fell upon the asylum of the great Saint Matanga.

sa: अथ रामो मुहूर्तस्य लब्धसंज्ञं महीपतिम्। उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्बाष्पशोकार्णवपरिप्लुतम्॥
en: When the lord of the earth oppressed with the vapour begot of grief and overwhelmed with emotion, had regained his senses, Rāma with joined palms said.

sa: इष्टकाश्च यथान्यायं कारिताश्च प्रमाणतः। चितोऽग्निर्ब्राह्मणैस्तत्र कुशलैः शिल्पकर्मणि॥
en: And an adequate number of bricks was also duly made (for the ceremony.) And Brāhmaṇas accomplished in the arts constructed the sacrificial fire-place with those bricks.

sa: अजिनोत्तरसंस्तीर्णे वरास्तरणसंचये। शयित्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रः कथं शेते महीतले॥
en: How can that chief of men having reposed in beds furnished with pillows made of deer-skins and having superb cloths, have lain down on the earth?

sa: स मयाऽऽहारसंरोधात् पीडितः प्रीतिवर्धनः। अनुमान्य यथातत्वमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hurt (by my speech uttered) in consequence of my non-receipt of food, that enhancer of my joy, asking my forgiveness, said these words fraught with fact,

sa: स्वधर्मस्य च संयोगाज्जितस्तेन महात्मना। स्वर्गः परिगृहीतश्च प्राणानपरिरक्षता॥
en: The abode of the celestials, which was conquered by this high-souled one by his former piety, has now been occupied by him after resigning his body.

sa: रात्रिं कथंचिदेवेमां सौमित्रे वर्तयामहे। अपवर्तामहे भूमावास्तीर्य स्वयमर्जितैः॥
en: We will, O son of Sumitrā, anyhow pass the night; let us ourselves procuring (leaves) and spreading them on the ground, anyhow lie down on it.

sa: पाण्डवानां हितं नित्यं हस्त्यश्वरथघातिनम्। वैहायसगतं युद्धे प्रेषयेर्यमसादनम्॥
en: That Rakshasa of fierce feats, born of men, ever devoted to the interests of the Pandavas and always slaying our elephants, horses and charioteer in battle.

sa: संसक्तं सूतपुत्रेण दृष्ट्वा भीममरिंदमम्। अतिभारममन्येतां भीमे कृष्णधनंजयौ॥४
en: Then beholding Bhima that subduer of foes engaged with the son of Suta, Krishna and Dhananjaya considered a heavy burden to be placed on the former.

sa: तथा द्रौपदिना द्रोणो न्यस्यसर्वायुधो युधि। युक्तयोगो महेष्वासः शरैर्बहुभिराचितः॥ निहतः खङ्गमुद्यम्य धृष्टद्युम्नेन संजय। अन्तरेण हतावेतौ छलेन च विशेषतः॥
en: So also, O Sanjaya, by Dhristadyumna, the son of Drupada, lifting up his sword, was slain that mighty bowman Drona, practising severe asceticisin, who, being already pierced by innumerable weapons had put aside all his weapons in battle. I have, indeed, heard of this, viz. that these two, Bhishma and Drona, were slain at a disadvantage and especially by means of a stratagem.

sa: द्रोणः पाञ्चालपुत्रेण बली बलवता सह। यदक्षिपत् पृषत्कौघांस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: The mighty Drona fought on with the powerful prince of the Panchalas and the myriads of shafts that he then discharged filled everybody with great wonder.

sa: सत्यसेनस्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध युधि पाण्डवम्। मित्रदेवस्त्रिषष्ट्या तु चन्द्रदेनस्तु सप्तभिः॥
en: In the battle, Satyasena penetrated the son of Pandu with three arrows; and Mitradeva pierced him with sixty-three; while indeed, Chandradeva pierced him with seven arrows.

sa: अवाकिरच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णै रुक्मपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः। विद्राव्य सर्वसैन्यानि तावकानि सहस्रशः॥
en: Covered them with keen pointed arrows furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone. Thus, o king, crushing all the warriors of your army by thousands.

sa: वातायमानैस्तैरश्वैरपानीयत संगरात्। ततस्तव सुता राजन् सैनिकाच विशाम्पते॥
en: Was borne away from the field of battle by his steeds of the fleetness of the wind. Thereupon, your other sons and the troops, () king.

sa: किरणैरिव सूर्यस्य महीथ्रो भरतर्षभ। कर्णचापच्युतैर्बाणैः प्राच्छाद्यत वृकोदरः॥
en: Vrikodara then, O foremost of the Bharatas, was covered with those shafts shot from Karna's bow, as if with the scattering rays of the blazing sun.

sa: अथान्येन सुपुढेन शरेणानतपर्वणा। आजधान भ्रुवोर्मध्ये धृष्टद्युम्नं परंतपः॥
en: Then that afflicter of his forces namely the son of Drona, pierced Dhristadyumna between his bows with another shaft of depressed knots furnished with beautiful wings.

sa: दंष्ट्राकरलोग्रमुखं शङ्कुकर्णं महाहनुम्। अर्ध्वकेशं विरूपाक्षं दीप्तास्यं निम्नितोदरम्॥
en: (He) had terrible teeth and a dreadful face, was possessed of arrow-like ears, high cheek bones, shooting hair, un-natural eyes, flaming mouth and a sunken belly.

sa: केचिद् भ्रान्तै रथैस्तूर्णं निहतैः पाणियन्तृभिः। विपताकध्वजच्छत्रैः पार्थिवाः शीर्णकूबरैः॥ भग्ननीडैराकुलाश्वैः प्रारुग्णाश्च विशेषतः। भग्नाक्षयुगचक्ष व्याकृष्यन्त समन्ततः॥
en: Some rulers of men fled on chariots borne along irregular courses, with parshni drivers slain, deprived of standards, streamers and umbrellas, with their boxes and Kuvaras shattered and all their decorations displaced. Others again, panic-struck and deprived of reason, goading the steeds of their chariots with their toes, fled in all haste.

sa: अभज्यताथ पृतना शैनेयशरपीडिता। ततः प्रायात्स त्वरितः सात्यकिःसत्यविक्रमः॥
en: Afflicted with the arrows shot by the grandson of Sini, the army then began to break away. Then Satyaki of unbaffled prowess proceeded with great velocity.

sa: ततश्चतुर्दिशं सैन्यैर्दुपदस्याभिसंवृतः। निर्दहन् क्षत्रियव्रातान् द्रोणः पर्यचरद् रणे॥
en: Then desirous of the compass were covered with the troops of Drupada's son. Consuming hosts of Kshatriyas Drona then careered on the field of battle. care

sa: ततस्रासो महानासीत् कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः। सर्वेषां चैव भूतानामुद्यतेऽने महात्मना॥
en: When that weapon was raised by highsouled Drona for use, the Kuru and the Pandava troops as also all the other creatures were stricken with panic.

sa: अपसव्यं कृतं संख्ये भ्रातृव्येनात्यमर्षिणा। नामृष्यत तमप्याजौ प्रतिचक्रेऽपसव्यतः॥
en: Though placed on the right by his enraged cousin, your son, inflamed with rage, began to resist him from even from that disadvantageous position of his.

sa: सर्वानविध्यन्निशितैर्दशभिर्दशभिः शरैः। उद्भूता रजसो वृष्टिः शरवृष्टिस्तथैव च॥
en: Then he pierced each of his foes with ten sharp shafts. The welkin was shrouded in a cloud of dust and showers of arrows fell thick.

sa: नासुरोगरक्षांसि क्षपयेयुः सहायुधम्। मूढास्त्वेतानि भाषन्ते यानीमान्यात्थ भारत॥
en: What you have spoken, 0 Bharata, is worthy of a fool only. Who ever returns safely to his own home, after having encountered Arjuna in battle?

sa: एवंशीलेषु व्रात्येषु वाहीकेषु दुरात्मसु॥ कश्चेतयानो निवसेनमुहूर्तमपि मानवः।
en: What man is there who will live willingly even for a moment in the midst of Bahikas who are so fallen, wicked and of fraudulent conduct?

sa: आहत: स महाबाहुर्भीमो भीमपराक्रमः॥ आकर्णपूणैर्विशिखैःकर्ण विव्याध सप्तभिः।
en: Thus struck by Karna the highly powerful and mighty-armed Bhima struck his antagonist in return with seven arrows shot off his bowstring drawn to his ear.

sa: विरथो भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रहसन्ननिलोपमः। गदां गृह्य महाबाहुरपतत् स्यन्दनोत्तमात्॥
en: O best of Bharatas, deprived of his car the mighty-armed Bhima, who resembled the Wind-god, took up a mace and jumped down from his excellent car.

sa: सूतपुत्रो जरासंघश्चेदिराजो निषादजः। सुयोधनं समाश्रित्य जयेयुः पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: The son of Suta, Jarasandha, the ruler of the Chedis and the prince of the Nishadas, these, united with Suyodhana, mighty have conquered the whole earth.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तानवश्यं वृणुयाद् रथसत्तमान्। तेऽस्मासु नित्यविद्विष्टाः संश्रयेयुश्च कौरवान्॥
en: Duryodhana would then surely have invited those foremost of car-warriors to embrace his cause and they, ever hostile to us, must have chosen the Kaurava party.

sa: शिखण्डी सहदेवश्च नकुलो नाकुलिस्तथा। जनमेजयः शिरेर्नप्ता बहवश्च प्रभद्रकाः॥ एते पुरोगमा भूत्वा धृष्टद्युम्नस्य संयुगे। कर्णमस्यन्तमिध्वस्त्रैर्विचेरुरमितौजसः॥
en: And many other warriors of immeasurable strength as Sikhandin, Sahadeva, Nakula, his sons, the descendant of Sini and a good many of the Prabhadrakas advancing along with Dhristadyumna in their respective cars looked very grand when they all began to strike Karna with their shafts and many other weapons of different descriptions.

sa: ततः परमनाराचैर्युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ। सात्यकिं च रथोदारं कम्पयामास मार्गणैः॥
en: Thereafter with a group of other arrows, consisting of Narachas, & c., the son of Suta caused Yudhamanyu, Uttamanjas and the mighty car-warrior Satyaki to tremble.

sa: किरीटिभुजनिर्मुक्तैः सम्पतद्भिर्महाशरैः। समाच्छन्नं बभौ सर्वं काद्रवेयैरिव प्रभो॥
en: Indeed those arrows, that were ceaselessly being discharged by Arjuna, falling on all sides looked, O lord, as if so many snakes were lying all around.

sa: जातरूपमयैः पुढेः शरांश्चानतपर्वणः। तैलधौतांश्च नाराचान् निर्मुक्तान् पन्नगानिव॥
en: The arrows having bent knots and gold studded wings and Naracha cleaned in oil are appearing as if numerous snakes have come out from their sloughs,

sa: वाजिपृष्ठगतस्यापि भूमिष्ठस्य च मारिष॥ नाज्ञासिषुर्धावमाना बहवश्च महारथाः।
en: Or on the backs of steeds or of those standing on the ground. O sire, many mighty car-warriors in the confusion of their flight perceived no.

sa: एते जिघृक्षवो यान्ति द्विपाश्वरथपत्तयः। युधिष्ठिरं धार्तराष्ट्रा नरोत्तममिवार्थिनः॥
en: Your army, riding on elephants, horses and cars and proceeding on foot are going to kill a Yudhishthira like poor men for possessing a costly gem.

sa: देवदानवगन्धर्वान् विजेतारो ह्यविस्मिताः। स्ववीर्यविजये युक्ता नैते परपरिग्रह्यः॥
en: They can defeat the very gods the Danavas and the Gandharvas. They confounded; they fight depending totally on their own energy. They never seek other's help.

sa: ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः शरैः शोणितभोजनैः। दुर्योधनं द्वादशभिर्माधवः प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: Thereupon the scion of Madhu's race pierced Duryodhana with twelve shafts shot from a full-drawn bow and capable of drinking the blood and mangling the skin.

sa: शैब्यो गोवासनो राजा योधैर्दशशतावरैः। काश्यस्याभिभुवः पुत्रं पराक्रान्तमवारयत्॥
en: Shaivya, the king of the Govasanas supported by a thousand excellent warriors, faced the son of the Kashi king and began to oppose that valorous prince.

sa: असम्भ्रान्तस्ततः पार्थो धनुराकृष्य वीर्यवान्। ततस्तदसमस्रेण स्तम्भयामास भारत॥
en: But the dauntless and puissant son of Pritha, in that fight taking up his bow, checked the career of that weapon with one of his own.

sa: प्रदीप्तोग्रशरार्चिष्मान् बभौ तत्र धनंजयः। सविस्फुलिङ्गाग्रशिखो ज्वलन्निव हुताशनः॥
en: Dhananjaya then shone resplendent with his arrows of glittering tips that seemed to constitute his rays, like a blazing fire with incessant scintillations and raging flames.

sa: विरराज भृशं चित्रा मही नववधूरिव। मञ्जामेदःकर्दमिनी शोणितौघतरङ्गिणीम्॥
en: The earth, highly beautified, appeared like a newly married bride. Having the marrow and fat (of slain creatures) for its mire, having blood for its current.

sa: तां शस्त्रवृष्टिमतुलां द्विपहस्तैः प्रवेरिताम्। चिच्छेद निशितैर्भल्लैरर्धचन्दैश्च फाल्गुनः॥
en: Phalguni cut-off with his broad-edged and crescent-shaped sharp arrows all those hosts of excellent weapons, although some of them were thrown by elephants with their tusks.

sa: अशक्यं कर्तुमन्येन सर्वभूतेषु भारत॥ निमेषान्तरमात्रेण साश्वसूतरथद्विपाम्। अक्षौहिणी राक्षसानां शितैर्बाणैरशातयत्॥ मिषतो भीमसेनस्य हैडिम्बेः पार्षतस्य च।
en: Incapable of being performed by any one among all the creatures. O Bharata, within the twinkling of an eyes, he destroyed by means of arrows one Akshauhini of the Rakshasa army together with horses, drivers, cars and elephants, in the very sight of Bhimasena, the son of Hidimva, the son of Prishatha.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नरथं गत्वा भैमसेनिस्ततो मृप। धनुर्घोरं समादाय महदिन्द्रायुधोपमम्।
en: Then, O king, riding on the car of Dhritarashtra and taking up a dreadful bow like the formidable bow of Indra (himself), the son of Bhimasena.

sa: द्रोणपुत्रस्तु विक्रान्तस्तद् वर्ष घोरमुच्छ्रितम्। शरैर्विध्वंसयामास वज्रकल्पैः शिलाशितैः॥
en: (But) Drona's son dauntlessly baffled that dreadful and impending shower of weapons by means of his own shafts, hard as the thunderbolt and sharpened on stones.

sa: तस्मादस्यावलेपस्य सद्यः फलमवाप्नुहि। त्वया तस्य धनुश्छिन्नमात्मनाशाय दुर्मते॥
en: You will, therefore, very soon feel the consequences of your offense. () wicked minded one, it was for your own destruction that you cut-off his bow.

sa: तावन्योन्यं शरैोरैश्छादयानौ महारथौ। रथवर्यगतौ वीरौ शुशुभाते बलोत्कटौ।॥
en: Those two mighty car-warriors, the two heroic warriors of terrible prowess, having covered each other with their dreadful shafts, looked very handsome, sitting upon their cars.

sa: स भिन्नहृदयो वाहान्नयपतन्मेदिनीतले। ततः सैन्यान्यकम्पन्त धृष्टद्युम्नसुते हते॥
en: With his heart cleft oper, he fell down on the ground from his vehicle. Upon the Death of Dhristadyumna's son, the troops to tremble (in fear).

sa: एकैकं दशभिः षड्भिरष्टाभिरपि भारत। द्विरदानभिविव्याध क्षिप्तैर्गिरिनिभाशरैः :॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, he (the Panchala chief) pierced every one of these elephants, that resembled mountains with ten, six or eight keen arrows.

sa: प्रजापतिरिदं सर्वं तपसैवासृजत् प्रभुः। तथैव वेदानृषयस्तपसा प्रतिपेदिरे॥
en: The powerful Creator created all this universe with the help of penances. In ihe same way, the Rishis won ihe Vedas by the power of penanccs.

sa: वेदोपवेदेष्वपरे युक्ताः स्वाध्यायपारगाः। श्राद्धयज्ञक्रियायां च तथा दानप्रतिग्रहे॥
en: Others endued with Vedic learning always read the Vedas and their auxiliaries or perform rites of faith and sacrificial acts, or make gifts or accept them.

sa: अहङ्कारकृतश्चैव सर्वे निरयगामिनः। परावमानी पुरुषो भविता निरयोपगः॥
en: They who follow the ritual with pride in their hearts, all go to hell. That Reciter who insults and disregards others has to go to hell.

sa: कृतस्य तु फलं तत्र प्रत्यक्षमुपलभ्यते। पानासनाशनोपेताः प्रासादभवनाश्रयाः॥
en: There the fruits of all sacred rites are visible. There some enjoy seats and best sorts of drinks and food, and live within palaces and mansions.

sa: तपः सुमहदास्थाय तोषयेशानमीश्वरम्। इह देवः सपत्नीकः समाक्रीडत्यधोक्षज॥
en: Practising severe penances, do you please Ishana, the Lord of all creatures. That divine Master called also Adhokshaja, sports here with his wife by his side.

sa: ज्वलितास्योऽभवद् घोरो वैवयं चागमत् परम्। गात्रकम्पश्च सुमहाश्वासश्चाप्यभवन्महान्॥
en: The heroic Asura's mouth began to send out flames of fire. He became greatly pale. His body began to tremble all over. His breath became hard.

sa: हिमवन्तमियाद् द्रष्टुं सिद्धचारणसेवितम्॥ तमप्सरोगणाकीर्णं शान्तस्वननिनादितम्। किन्नराणां सहस्रैश्च भृङ्गराजैस्तथैव च॥ मद्गुभिः खजरीटैच विचित्रैर्जीवजीवकैः॥ चित्रवर्णैर्मयूरैश्च केकाशतविराजितैः।
en: Those mountains were full of various clans of Apsaras and echoed with many soft sounds. Filled with thousands of Kinnaras and Bhringarajas, it was adorned, besides, with many Madgus and Khanjaritas and many Jivajivakas of variegated colour. And there were many peacocks also of gorgeous hues, uttering their shrill but melodious cries.

sa: अलं स्थित्वा श्मशानेऽस्मिन् गृध्रगोमायुसंकुले। कङ्कालबहुले रौद्रे सर्वप्राणिभयङ्करे॥
en: There is no necessity of your waiting in the crematorium, this dreadful place, which abounds with vultures, jackals and skeletons and fills every creature with fear.

sa: स पुनर्योगमास्थाय मोक्षमार्गोपलब्धये। महायोगेश्वरो भूत्वा सोऽत्यकामद् विहायसम्॥
en: He once more set himself to Yoga for acquiring the path of Liberation. Becoming the great master of Yoga he got over the element of ether.

sa: पुण्यपापमयं देहं क्षपयन् कर्मसंक्षयात्। क्षीणदेहः पुनर्देही ब्रह्मत्वमुपगच्छति॥
en: Deprived of body, because freed through the dissipation of acts from bodies that are the outcome of merits and demerits, individual at last attains to Brahma.

sa: दूतसंव्यवहाराश्च निष्परीक्षाश्च मानवाः। प्राणिहिंसाप्रवृत्ताश्च ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who are given to gambling, they who unhesitatingly perform wicked acts, and they who are given to killing living creatures, have to sink in hell.

sa: राजहंससमूहैश्च कृष्णैः परभृतैस्तथा॥ पक्षिराजो गरुत्मांश्च यं नित्यमधितिष्ठति।
en: Many bevies of swans also, and many flights of gladdened coils, too, adorned the place. The king of birds, viz., Garuda, live on that suimit constantly.
